title: Atorvastatin 40 mg tablets
content: Brand Lipitor, NDC 00071-0156-23. HMG-CoA reductase inhibitor for lowering LDL cholesterol. Contraindicated in active liver disease and pregnancy. Avoid combination with clarithromycin because CYP3A4 inhibition raises statin exposure.

title: Metformin 500 mg tablets
content: Brand Glucophage, NDC 00087-6060-05. First-line oral biguanide for type 2 diabetes. Contraindicated when eGFR is below 30 mL/min and in metabolic acidosis. Common adverse effects are nausea and diarrhea.

title: Lisinopril 10 mg tablets
content: Brand Zestril, NDC 00310-0131-10. ACE inhibitor for hypertension and heart failure. Contraindicated with a history of angioedema and in pregnancy. Monitor potassium and creatinine after starting.

title: Warfarin 5 mg tablets
content: Brand Coumadin, NDC 00056-0172-70. Vitamin K antagonist anticoagulant dosed to an INR target of 2.0 to 3.0. Major interaction with aspirin and NSAIDs raising bleeding risk. Contraindicated in active bleeding.

title: Amoxicillin 500 mg capsules
content: Brand Amoxil, NDC 65862-0008-05. Penicillin-class antibiotic. Contraindicated in patients with documented penicillin hypersensitivity. Dose adjustment is needed when creatinine clearance is below 30 mL/min.

title: Insulin glargine 100 units/mL
content: Brand Lantus, NDC 00088-2220-33. Long-acting basal insulin given once daily. Hypoglycemia is the main adverse effect. Do not mix with other insulins in the same syringe.

title: Clarithromycin 500 mg tablets
content: Brand Biaxin, NDC 00074-3368-60. Macrolide antibiotic and strong CYP3A4 inhibitor. Contraindicated with simvastatin, lovastatin and colchicine in renal impairment. May prolong the QT interval.

title: Levothyroxine 50 mcg tablets
content: Brand Synthroid, NDC 00074-6624-90. Synthetic thyroid hormone replacement taken on an empty stomach. Contraindicated in uncorrected adrenal insufficiency. Separate from calcium and iron by four hours.

title: Salbutamol inhaler 100 mcg
content: Brand Ventolin, NDC 00173-0682-20. Short-acting beta-2 agonist reliever for asthma and COPD. Adverse effects include tremor and tachycardia. Overuse signals poor asthma control.

title: Apixaban 5 mg tablets
content: Brand Eliquis, NDC 00003-0894-21. Direct factor Xa inhibitor for stroke prevention in atrial fibrillation. Contraindicated in active pathological bleeding. Reduce the dose to 2.5 mg twice daily with two of: age 80 or older, weight 60 kg or less, creatinine 1.5 mg/dL or more.
